').filter(f=>f.startsWith('docs/')&&f.endsWith('.md')&&!f.includes('index.md')&&!f.includes('references/'));let errors=[];files.forEach(f=>{if(!f)return;const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const species=c.split('
